name: Christina Pahl Interiors
audience: Atherton, Los Altos, Menlo Park, Portola Valley, Sunnyvale and Stanford-area clients
description: Boutique Palo Alto interior design firm for residential interiors and executive offices, describing a collaborative process that starts with listening and works to the client budget.
insight: Their own site lists nine affluent areas served, then shows nothing to justify the enquiry - the clearest conversion gap in the professional-services group.
usps: Residential and workplace under one practice
differentiators: Presents projects as documented case studies with constraints and outcomes, not a photo grid

reputation.note: No review surface captured; the firm sells by portfolio and referral.

afford: Design fees on residential projects locally run 10-20 percent of furnishing spend
Office of nine areas served implies sustained project flow
A design firm understands the value of a good website: easier sale, higher standard
risk: Extremely high design bar: a mediocre site is worse than the template they have
Portfolio usage rights for photographed projects must be cleared

art.logo: Set a lower-case serif wordmark, no monogram flourish
art.photoNote: Rooms, material layouts, drawings - client-approved imagery only

copy.h1: Your interiors deserve better than our website.
copy.sub: Residential and executive office design in Palo Alto, Atherton and Los Altos - documented properly this time.
copy.lede: A practice whose whole discipline is taste: space planning, colour, furnishings and art selection for Palo Alto homes, from a designer who has run her own studio for over twenty years.

concept.dir: Gallery-quiet portfolio site: large image fields with thin captions, a services-and-fee structure page, a project index by type, and an enquiry form that asks about scope and timeline. Very little motion; excellent typography.
interactive: Project index with hover captions and filters
Enquiry form with project-type and budget band
concept.refs: A design-practice monograph, not a lead-gen page.

web.note: Audited via the site itself: a single-page builder layout, a yahoo.com contact address, a list of areas served and a gallery - no project case studies, no process, no enquiry flow. A firm whose job is taste, represented by a template.

photoAlt: Concept artwork for Christina Pahl Interiors — generated design direction, not a photograph of the premises

design.label: Design Studio Portfolio
design.summary: Plan-drawing geometry, project index with hover previews, oversized caption numerals, section-scroll reveals, fee-and-process transparency for design-build.
